text:
The evidence is inconclusive, and the claim is marked "contradicted." Hansen satellite data mapped about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020 (0.02% of the 3,643.5 ha property). That is above the 0.5 ha minimum event size. The independent JRC 2020 reference map shows none of that area as forest (0% agreement, against the 50% required). So the two sources disagree.

Most of the area is mapped as planted pine (about 0.4 ha, Pinus elliottii/taeda). The rest is outside mapped forest (0.3 ha). Hansen also shows another 1.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which is not counted as an event.

This does not show that loss definitely occurred, nor that none did. It also does not show deforestation or land-use change, because Hansen counts any stand replacement, such as cutting a plantation. Nor does it show the cause.
